description: Use when an agent has a name or phrase and needs the `(source, id)` of the matching event or market before calling another tool. Resolves free text against events AND markets in one call, best-first, and reports `total_events` / `total_markets` so the agent can tell a precise hit from an ambiguous one. Every row carries `event_path`, the internal link to use for follow-up lookups. Prefer this over running `list_events?search=` and `list_markets?search=` separately when the goal is identification rather than a filtered listing. Note: `headline` carries literal `<b>` highlight markup — quote `title` instead, or strip the tags.

limit.description: Maximum number of coalesced results to return (1-20, default 8). `total_events` / `total_markets` in the envelope are uncapped and reflect the full match count, not this limit.
limit.title: Limit

q.description: Free-text query, matched against event titles and market questions. Queries shorter than 2 characters deliberately return an empty result set rather than half the dataset.
q.title: Q

name: search_suggest

outputSchema.description:
Envelope kept distinct from `Page` because suggest never paginates
— `total` is meaningless when ranking truncates aggressively at 8.

But we *do* expose total match counts so the frontend can render a
"View all N results" deep-link footer (the typeahead becomes a
launchpad to the markets page, not a dead-end at 8 hits).

anyOf.description: Agent metadata for list/aggregate responses (no cite_as).

attribution.default: pdata.world — aggregated prediction-market data across 8 platforms
attribution.title: Attribution

anyOf.title: ResponseMetaList

headline.description: `title` with the query's matched fragments wrapped in literal ``/`` tags (Postgres `ts_headline` output), for callers that render highlighted search rows. This is markup, not prose: non-rendering consumers — LLM agents especially — should quote `title` instead, or strip the tags before echoing this field. Null when the row was matched without highlighting.
headline.title: Headline
